title: Known exploited vulnerability check
description: Is this CVE known to be exploited in the wild? Returns whether it is in the CISA KEV catalog, date added, CISA due date, required action and known ransomware use. Parameter: cve=CVE-YYYY-NNNN. Source: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog (CC0), refreshed daily. Absence from KEV is not proof of safety. Not endorsed by CISA.

title: Known exploited vulnerabilities by vendor/product
description: All CISA KEV entries for a vendor and/or product (2-64 chars), each labelled exact/word/substring match, newest first, with dueDate, requiredAction and ransomware use. Parameters: vendor, product, min_quality (exact|word|substring, default word), limit (1-100). Source: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog (CC0), refreshed daily. Absence from KEV is not proof of safety. Not endorsed by CISA.
